airtable.note: API key stored in .env as AIRTABLE_API_KEY

telnyx.note: API key stored in .env as TELNYX_API_KEY

google.note: Google OAuth credentials stored in n8n credential store (Google Drive + Google Docs)

n8n.note: API key stored in .env as N8N_API_KEY

action_queue_executor.name: [Agent Intelligence] Action Queue Executor
action_queue_executor.note: Handles action types: send_sms, move_campaign, escalate_airtable, sync_airtable_task, push_instantly_lead, push_instantly_sequences, upload_google_drive, send_email_report

shipday_delivery_collector.name: [Evidence Collection] Shipday Delivery Collector
shipday_delivery_collector.note: Fetches Shipday orders and POSTs to POST /api/shipday/ingest-orders

google_docs_sync.name: [Evidence Collection] Google Docs Sync
google_docs_sync.note: Inactive until Google Drive + Google Docs OAuth2 credentials are configured in n8n.

campaign_performance_tracker.name: DabbahWala — Campaign Performance Tracker
campaign_performance_tracker.note: Every hour: GET campaign IDs from Render, fetch analytics per campaign from Instantly, POST stats back to Render DB

instantly_campaign_sync.name: DabbahWala — Instantly Campaign Sync
instantly_campaign_sync.note: Calls POST /api/webhooks/sync-campaigns to fetch Instantly campaigns tagged 'dabbahwala' and upsert into instantly_campaigns DB table.

shipday_feedback_sync.name: DabbahWala — Shipday Feedback Sync
shipday_feedback_sync.note: Calls POST /api/shipday/sync-feedback (days_back=3, synchronous). Polls Shipday API for customer feedback, delivery instructions, and proof-of-delivery on all delivered orders not yet synced. Stores in shipday_communications, fires delivery_update events, creates Opportunities for actionable sentiment. If new comms found, triggers POST /api/lifecycle/run.

shipday_historical_import.name: DabbahWala — Shipday Historical Import (Manual)
shipday_historical_import.note: One-shot backfill: kicks off POST /api/shipday/import-all-and-run-agents (days_back=365, max_pages=500). Polls pipeline status at 5 min, 15 min, and 35 min, then logs a summary. Run once to seed the database with up to 1 year of Shipday orders, contacts, and delivery dates.

instantly_setup.name: DabbahWala — Instantly Setup
instantly_setup.note: Calls POST /api/campaigns/setup-instantly daily. No-op if all 6 campaigns already exist in Instantly. Runs full setup (create missing, configure sequences, tag) only if campaigns are missing or duplicates are detected.

daily_order_upload.name: [Orders] Daily Order Upload
daily_order_upload.note: Uploads CSV to POST /api/daily-orders/process. Response includes shipday_csv_download_url for Shipday import.

daily_activity_report.name: [Reporting] Daily Activity Report
daily_activity_report.note: Calls POST /api/agents/report/activity which returns html_body + csv_content. n8n sends email.

daily_outcome_report.name: [Reporting] Daily Outcome Report
daily_outcome_report.note: Calls POST /api/agents/report/outcome which returns html_body + csv_content. n8n sends email.

google_docs.note: Set up Google Drive + Google Docs OAuth2 credentials in n8n. Folder ID is hardcoded in workflow.

classification.ad_copy: Title contains: ad copy, social media, facebook, instagram, social post
classification.ground_note: Title contains: field note, ground, delivery note, driver (or default)
